extName.message: Owned Elsewhere — library checker for Steam

extDescription.message: Shows on Steam store pages which games you already own in Epic Games Store, GOG, Xbox, Ubisoft and other libraries.

chooseSource.message: Where is your library? Pick a source to see how to export it.

dropFormats.message: GOG Galaxy database (.db), CSV/TSV (Playnite, GOG Galaxy Export Script, spreadsheets), Heroic JSON, text list (.txt), backup (.json)

src_galaxy_steps.message:
Install GOG Galaxy 2.0 and sign in with a GOG account (free).
Connect your stores: Settings (gear icon, top left) → Integrations → Connect next to Epic Games Store, Xbox, Ubisoft Connect, EA app, Amazon Games, Battle.net and others. Connect Steam too — then the extension knows what you already have on Steam.
Wait until the games appear under “All games” (usually a few minutes).
Quit GOG Galaxy completely: tray icon → Exit. While it runs, the newest changes may not be written to the file yet.
Press the button below, paste the path into the “File name” field and press Enter (ProgramData is a hidden folder, the path is the easy way in).

src_galaxy_note.message: Xbox libraries in Galaxy also contain Game Pass games, so Xbox matches are shown as “maybe” — change this under “Store trust”.

src_playnite_steps.message:
In Playnite press F9 (Add-ons) → Browse → Generic, find “Library Exporter Advanced”, install it and restart Playnite.
Open the add-on settings (F9 → Installed → Generic → Library Exporter Advanced) and enable at least the columns Name, Sources and Platforms. Platforms tells PC games from Xbox console games.
Export: Playnite main menu → Extensions → Library Exporter Advanced → Export library, save the CSV file.
Drop the file here or press the button below. No need to rename the columns: an export in any Playnite language works, titles with commas are read correctly.

src_playnite_note.message: Playnite’s Xbox library lists every game you have launched, including Game Pass and Games with Gold titles, so Xbox matches are shown as “maybe owned”. You can confirm them under “Check Xbox games”.

playniteNoPlatform.message: Tip: add the Platforms column to the export to tell Xbox console games from PC games.

src_heroic_steps.message:
Open Heroic and sign in to Epic, GOG and/or Amazon under “Manage accounts”. Wait until the library has loaded.
Press the button below and open the store_cache folder (paths below). Choose legendary_library.json for Epic, gog_library.json for GOG, nile_library.json for Amazon — several files can be selected at once.

src_stores_title.message: Epic, Xbox, Ubisoft, EA, Amazon, Battle.net

src_stores_steps.message:
These stores have no library export of their own. Collect them through one of the apps below — they connect to all of these stores:
GOG Galaxy 2.0 — the most accurate: gives exact Steam IDs for most games.
Playnite — any language, distinguishes PC and console games if you export the Platforms column.
Heroic Games Launcher — Epic, GOG and Amazon only.

src_galaxycsv_steps.message:
Install Python 3 and download GOG Galaxy Export Script (github.com/AB1908/GOG-Galaxy-Export-Script).
Quit GOG Galaxy, then in the script folder run: python galaxy_library_export.py
Choose the resulting gameDB.csv.

src_galaxycsv_note.message: Loading galaxy-2.0.db directly is more accurate: it also gives Steam IDs.

src_csv_steps.message:
Any table saved as CSV or TSV works (Excel, Google Sheets, other launchers). It needs a column with the game title; a store column and a Steam App ID column make matching better.
Any delimiter and encoding (UTF-8, Windows-1251) is fine. If the columns are not recognised, you will be asked to pick them.

src_list_steps.message:
Paste titles below, one game per line, or load a .txt file.
You can add the store after a tab, “ | ” or “;”, e.g. “Hades | Epic”. Otherwise the store selected below is used.

pastePlaceholder.message:
Disco Elysium
Grand Theft Auto V | Epic Games Store

src_backup_steps.message: Restores libraries and settings saved with “Save backup” — for example, in another browser or on another computer.

errNotGalaxyDb.message: This database is not a GOG Galaxy 2.0 library.

errNoGamesFound.message: No games found in this file.

txtLoaded.message: Text list loaded below: pick its store and press Import.

mapHint.message: The file columns were not recognised automatically. Pick them once — the rest is automatic.

confirmRestore.message: Replace current libraries and settings with this backup?

storesHint.message: “Owned” — a library entry means you bought the game. “Maybe owned” — a softer note: the store also lists subscription games (Xbox Game Pass, Games with Gold), console versions, or Windows-only releases when you play on macOS or Linux. Steam games are never reported as “elsewhere”: they only tell the extension that you already have the game on Steam.

set_showBundles.message: Show how much of a bundle you already own

set_showInLists.message: Mark games in search, wishlist, cart and store lists

set_matchByTitle.message: Match by title when there is no Steam ID

set_matchEditions.message: Note other editions (e.g. “GTA V” for “GTA V Legacy”) as “maybe”

set_showDlcBase.message: On DLC pages, note if the base game is owned

ignoredEmpty.message: None. Use × on a Steam page or “Don’t mark” above to hide a wrong match.

ignoreGame.message: Don’t mark this game (e.g. it was from a subscription)

privacyNote.message: Your library stays in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.

popupHint.message: Files are added on a full page: a popup closes when the file dialog opens.

popupEmpty.message: No libraries yet. Add one to start.

winOnlyNoteMac.message: The release in that store is for Windows only — it will not run on your Mac.

winOnlyNoteLinux.message: The release in that store is for Windows only — on Linux it needs Proton/Wine (e.g. Heroic, Lutris), while the Steam version can run through Steam Play.

osUnknownNote.message: Check that $2 has a $1 version — the library file does not say.

hideInSteam.message: Hide in Steam: I own it elsewhere

hiddenInSteam.message: Hidden in Steam (Ignore → “Own it on another store”).

hideInSteamError.message: Steam did not accept the request. Are you signed in?

hideInSteamTip.message: Uses Steam’s own “Ignore” with the reason “I own it on another store”: the game stops appearing in recommendations and, if enabled in Steam, in search. Undo any time here or on the game page.

set_showCommunity.message: Mark games on Steam profile game lists (yours and friends’) — asks for access to steamcommunity.com

set_hideInSteamButton.message: Show the “Hide in Steam” button on game pages

xboxHint.message: Xbox libraries mix bought games with Game Pass and Games with Gold titles, console-only releases and old Xbox 360 / Games for Windows Live licences, and miss bought games you never launched. Mark each game once — the mark then overrides the store trust setting. If a console game supports Xbox Play Anywhere, choose “Bought — playable on PC”.
